context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

We copied a k8sattributes / resource / transform processor chain into our self-managed collector and export logs, metrics, and traces to the normal coralogix exporter. The k8s.* resource attributes are present on telemetry, but Infrastructure Explorer inventory is still empty. What collector path are we missing?

checklist.name: cluster-collector-level
checklist.description: The response matches the pattern: (cluster-collector|cluster collector|cluster-level collector|cluster level collector)

checklist.name: explains-that-the-k8sattributes-resource-tran
checklist.description: Explains that the k8sattributes / resource / transform chain only adds resource attributes for correlation and does not create Resource Catalog inventory entries by itself. For a self-managed collector, names the missing inventory path: k8sobjects receiver on the cluster-collector, resourcedetection/resource_catalog, and the dedicated coralogix/resource_catalog exporter with the x-coralogix-ingress: metadata-as-otlp-logs/v1 logs header. FAIL if the response says the normal coralogix exporter or k8sattributes processor alone should populate Infrastructure Explorer inventory.
